latest.title: Fed study finds crypto investors driven by beliefs, easily swayed by returns
latest.description: A Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland study finds crypto investors hold sharply different views on returns and risk, while information about Bitcoin’s past gains can increase both desired allocations and actual crypto purchases.

latest.title: Crypto card spending tops $1 billion as stablecoins move into everyday purchases
latest.description: Tracked card volume more than tripled in a year, with USDC and USDT funding over 70% of spending as users increasingly paid for groceries, rides and subscriptions.

latest.description: Money is flooding into equal-weight stock market ETFs this year. Investing experts say it's not a fad.

latest.title: Crypto’s next billion users might be AI agents, and they’re paying with stablecoins
latest.description: According to Coinbase’s head of AI product, we’re currently in the “Napster/LimeWire era” of agentic payments.

latest.title: Small UK power generator shut down after cyberattack linked to Iran: Telegraph
latest.description: The U.K. government says the incident did not pose a risk to the country's energy system, adding that it briefed CEOs of companies in the sector with advice.

latest.title: Wells Fargo and Citigroup have room to buy a big bank. These 5 regionals fit the bill
latest.description: Citigroup and Wells Fargo have room to buy a big regional bank as regulators have opened the door to megadeals. Five regional banks make sense as targets.

latest.title: After 10 years at United, CEO Scott Kirby is thinking big about the future of his airline from JFK to AI

latest.title: Top Wall Street analysts believe in the growth potential of these 3 stocks

latest.title: As U.S.-Canada trade talks collapse, Carney says retaliatory tariffs will start Sept. 8
latest.description: New 50% Trump administration tariffs on some Canadian exports went into place after the U.S. and Canada failed to reach a deal on Friday.

latest.title: Nvidia customers reportedly warned about AI-related price hikes
latest.description: The chipmaker has told some of its largest customers that the prices of servers containing its AI chips could move more than 15% higher, Bloomberg News reported.

latest.title: Trump reshuffled his portfolio in June, selling names like Meta and buying Berkshire Hathaway
latest.description: President Donald Trump disclosed just over 1,000 financial transactions in the month of June in what appears to be broad reshuffling of his portfolio.

latest.title: Microsoft Fixes 'Perfect 10' Exploit That Could Have Let Hackers Run Code Remotely
latest.description: The Entra ID flaw earned the highest possible severity score, but Microsoft says it patched the bug before publishing the CVE and found no evidence it was ever exploited.

latest.title: AI Has Made Bitcoin Software a Target—This Group Is Fighting Back
latest.description: A group of 20-odd developers is scanning the Bitcoin ecosystem for AI-discoverable flaws, warning that cheap, powerful models have handed attackers unprecedented reach.
